description: This is a test script for the Work Order doctype in ERPNext manufacturing module. It contains test cases for various manufacturing workflows, including stock entry, work order processing, scrap handling, capacity planning, and job card management.

classes.name: TestWorkOrder
classes.description: A test case class for testing manufacturing work order workflows in ERPNext.

methods.name: update_job_card
methods.description: Updates a job card with scrap items and completes a time log.

methods.name: get_scrap_item_details
methods.description: Fetches scrap item details from BOM scrap items.

methods.name: allow_overproduction
methods.description: Sets overproduction percentage in Manufacturing Settings.

methods.name: make_wo_order_test_record
methods.description: Creates a test Work Order record with specified parameters.
